Verified live 2026-08-19 via GET https://api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/KPMGAustralia1/postings — HTTP 200, 92 postings, 80 AU-wide. NOTE: the SmartRecruiters adapter fetches a detail page per posting (see src/job_discovery/sources/smartrecruiters.py) and the project rate-limits to one request per 2s per host — 92 postings means this employer alone adds roughly 3 minutes to a discovery run.

First real-world validation of the crawlee_jsonld adapter. Verified live 2026-09-14: stripe.com/robots.txt permits User-agent:*  under /careers/*; the listing at https://stripe.com/careers/search has 20 server-rendered <a href='/careers/listing/...'> anchors on page 1; every detail page carries one <script type='application/ld+json'> with @type=JobPosting, parsed cleanly by the project's existing parse_job_postings (title/company/location/identifier.value). Pagination past page 1 is JavaScript-driven, so a static-HTTP crawl only reaches the first 20 postings — this entry is left disabled by default because Stripe is not AU-focused and the reduced coverage is not useful for Ishmam's real job search; enable it if you want to try the Crawlee path against real data.
